arch = sm_90
Function _Z11kimi_kernel1P:

To parallelize MLA’s context scan, the agent separated softmax normalization from the latent-value accumulation. The new helper assigns each grid block a head/latent tile and a context partition, then writes partial sums:

__device__ void mla_c_part(const float* probs,const B* c,float* part,int T,int nb){
    constexpr int N=H*KV,tiles=N/THREADS;int tile=blockIdx.x%tiles,sid=blockIdx.x/tiles;
    int ns=(nb-1-tile)/tiles+1,n=tile*THREADS+threadIdx.x;
    int lo=(T*sid)/ns,hi=(T*(sid+1))/ns,h=n/KV,r=n%KV;float a=0;
    for(int t=lo;t<hi;++t)a=fmaf(probs[t*H+h],lb(c+t*KV+r),a);
    part[blockIdx.x*THREADS+threadIdx.x]=a;
}

The caller then reduced those partials into the latent result, with grid-wide synchronization between stages:

mla_softmax(scores,probs,p.L+1,sh);grid.sync();
mla_c_part(probs,p.cout,p0,p.L+1,nb);grid.sync();gemv_reduce(p0,cs,H*KV,nb,false);grid.sync();

For each quantization group, the GEMV now accumulates integer-weight products and the activation sum, applying the group parameters after the loop:

sx += x0 + x1;

Important non-obvious context

The task files specify an RTX PRO 6000, but this run was evaluated and cataloged on an H100. The final solution uses plain CUDA through load_inline; it computes int4 unpacking and dequantization itself. Its group-128 asymmetric W4A16 GEMV accumulates each quantization group as (sum(q*x) - zero*sum(x))*scale, avoiding materialized dequantized weights.

step() performs cache-view and workspace bookkeeping, then launches exactly one cooperative kernel. The kernel uses an occupancy-sized grid and cooperative_groups::grid_group barriers between phases. Recording summary

The final model preserves the reference parameter and buffer structure for strict weight loading. It implements three KDA layers with recurrent state updates and short causal convolution, followed by MLA over the growing compressed KV cache. Each layer includes RMSNorm, residuals, and a 64-expert MoE with top-8 routing plus one shared expert. Quantized projection and expert GEMVs unpack int4 values and dequantize within the kernel; split-K partials and grid-wide reductions distribute the work.
